payload.title: First staged backend deploy, edge stack and DNS for dataparade.anth.us
payload.description: Blocked on Ryan: Google OAuth client plus ~/Projects/dataparade-store-google-secrets.sh, then the Amplify console Connect repository step on app d35q7zv4zad2we. Then: first main build with backend.excludeModelGroups editions, remove the exclusion and deploy again, create papyrus-edge-dataparade (infra/edge/dataparade.yaml), set edgeDistributionArn in papyrus.config.ts, add the dataparade alias record in the anth.us zone Z04979341DPRV5BDQNZMG. Verify /newsroom returns 200 and the stub returns 200.
